record.question: The current Vice President of India is
record.explanation: Answer C: Hamid Ansari. M. Hamid Ansari was Vice President of India from 11 August 2007 to 10 August 2017, including the June 2014 paper. The official Vice President archive gives those dates. Historical/source note: Current refers to June 2014; this is not a present-day officeholder claim. Reference: https://vicepresidentofindia.nic.in/former-head/sh-m-hamid-ansari/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
